title: TracksStreamRecord
description: Data contract for each JSONL record in tracks_stream.jsonl exchanged between Person A (Perception & MOT) and Person B (Geometry, BEV & Spatial Analytics).

camera_id.description: Unique identifier of the camera source (e.g., hcmc_city_new_4, hanoi_vntraffic_01).

frame_id.description: Zero-based or non-negative frame index in the video stream.

timestamp_ms.description: Frame timestamp in milliseconds from the start of the video.

fps.description: Video frame rate in frames per second (> 0).

bbox_xyxy.description: Bounding box in pixel coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2].

footpoint_uv.description: Ground contact point at bottom-center of bbox [(x1 + x2) / 2, y2] in pixel coordinates.
